title: Functional Platform AIV Engineer
full_description:

We want you as a talented Functional Platform Assembly, Integration and Verification (AIV) Engineer to help us in our mission by closing the system level verifications.
Key Responsibilities
In your capacity as a Functional Platform AIV Engineer, your role will continuously evolve, but initially your day-to-day duties will include:
Support the definition and implementation of the Nyx Earth system software and hardware integration and verification activities, which meets technical and programmatic requirements and considers the adequacy of model philosophy, facilities availability, planning and costing.
Define test plans and specifications with clear Success Criteria and support the generation of test procedures with the team.
Support the preparation, organization and execution of the spacecraft functional system test campaigns to ensure the closure of all system verification aspects, including nominal and off nominal spacecraft behaviors.
Coordinate the integration and test of subsystems and components to ensure alignment and connectivity of the integrated systems
Organise the different test reviews such as Test Readiness Review, Post Test Review and Test Review Board.
Generate tests reports and drive the closure of the Items for Verification and Validation covered by the test campaign.
Collaborate with all Functional Chain responsible and engineering disciplines to prepare and perform the tests.
Process the anomalies occurring during the test campaign in coordination with the Product Assurance Team and the rest of the Engineering Team.
What We Would Love To See From You
In the role of AIV Engineer ideally, you will have the following:
1 to 5 years of experience in systems design, analysis, and testing of aerospace or space-related systems.
Hands-on hardware experience.
Practical experience / contact with functional test platforms, such as software in the loop, hardware in the loop, and bench testing.
Experience in the development and verification of space hardware.
Spacecraft systems knowledge, with a focus on flight software, avionics, and guidance, navigation, and control.
Skills And Behaviours
Strong oral and written communication skills
Strong analysis and problem-solving skills
Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks
Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done
Ability to communicate at all levels of the business
Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork
Space enthusiast: ready to change the European space industry
Ability to thrive in a high paced development environment
Why you should join us!
What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:
We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind
We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them
We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?
